description: A new international consortium of bio-labs, alarmed by the bio_uplift_findings and untrusting of state-led initiatives, independently begins a distributed red-teaming effort using open-weight models to probe for dangerous biological designs. The effort is decentralized, underfunded, and controversial, but produces early evidence of multiple plausible attack vectors. This emergent development increases pressure on formal institutions to act and may accelerate the bio gate closure timeline.
